_comment: Model prices in USD per million tokens. This file is CONFIGURATION, not code: prices
change, and a wrong number here silently corrupts every cost report. Each entry names
where its numbers came from. A model that is not listed is reported as unpriced rather
than priced with a guess — see src/model/cost.ts.
cacheWritePerMTok defaults to 1.25x input and cacheReadPerMTok to 0.10x input, the
standard five-minute cache premium and discount; entries override them where the model
